aggregation_recipe: Join by packet/pair/candidate keys and reject duplicate/missing keys.
For each field and candidate, count distinct reviewer values: 1=all agree; 2=two agree; 3=all different.
Retain unclear as its own value; never convert agreement to accuracy.
A related/off-topic pair requires unanimous opposite determinate labels for its two candidates.
High-confidence pair additionally requires all three confidence values high for each candidate.
Natural pair additionally requires all three naturalness values natural for each candidate.
Post-review strict descriptive filter additionally requires sufficient context, no redaction impact and exact evidence spans.
Report host counts separately; do not treat multiple pairs/reviewers as independent events.
